incidente.resumo: On August 14 (year not stated in the text), all GitHub services on GitHub.com were inaccessible for all users for 36 minutes, with no data loss or corruption. An erroneous configuration change to GitHub.com databases impacted their ability to respond to health check pings from the routing service, so the hosts were considered unhealthy and the production read-only database endpoint became inaccessible. The configuration change was reverted and all services recovered at 23:38 UTC.

descricao.texto: At 22:59 UTC an erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases and impacted their ability to respond to health check pings from the routing service; the hosts were considered unhealthy, the production read-only database endpoint became inaccessible, and the application could no longer connect to critical data for read operations.
trechos: At 22:59 UTC, an erroneous configuration change rolled out to GitHub.com databases that impacted the ability of the database to respond to health check pings from the routing service.
This led to these database hosts being considered unhealthy and the production read-only database endpoint became inaccessible.
As a result, the application could no longer connect to critical data for read operations.
